description: A literal-union key narrows to exactly those members: `id`/`className` are both clean getters, so the read is green, while swapping one for `innerHTML` reports and names the getter that is throwing.

diagnostics.message: Reading `element[key]` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the getter `innerHTML`, which is colored `throwing` by the shipped DOM baseline, so calling it can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; or, if it cannot throw, report it against the shipped DOM baseline at https://github.com/MidnightDesign/no-throw/issues — the other three carriers are keyed by npm package name, and no key in that grammar reaches a `lib.*.d.ts` member.
